To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) there is no clear answer to the question if hand-crafted features are still relevant in paralinguistic tasks and (2) that it depends on the data set.

(i) the performance of hand-crafted features depends on the task, (ii) the performance of a DNN depends on the complexity of the features, and (iii) the performance of the DNN is not necessarily better than the performance of the best hand-crafted features.

(1) hand-crafted and DNN features perform comparably, (2) hand-crafted feature engineering is still a valuable tool, (3) DNNs can learn to extract features, (4) DNNs cannot learn to extract features from scratch, but need a good initialization and (5) DNNs are not able to learn the same features as hand-crafted features

the question of whether hand-crafted features can still be relevant in the era of deep learning.
